data: Natječaj za postdoktoranda na HRZZ projektu GlycoBrain (2)

Genos d.o.o. za vještačenje i analizu raspisuje natječaj za zapošljavanje jednog (1) zaposlenika (m/ž) na radno mjesto postdoktoranda na projektu Programa „Istraživački Projekt" Hrvatske zaklade za znanost „Dekodiranje moždanog glikoma: Ciljano glikoproteomsko istraživanje ljudskog mozga" (akronim: GlycoBrain):

  • Radno mjesto: jedan (1) postdoktorand za rad na aktivnostima projekta koji uključuju analizu glikozilacije proteina pod mentorstvom dr. sc. Thomasa Klarića (Genos)

Ugovor o radu sklapa se na određeno vrijeme dok traje projekt (do 30.11.2027.) u punom radnom vremenu.

Obavezni uvjeti:

  • završen odgovarajući doktorski studij iz područja prirodnih znanosti (molekularna biologija, eksperimentalna biologija, biokemija) ili biomedicine i zdravstva (medicina, farmacija, medicinska biokemija)
  • izvrsno poznavanje engleskog jezika i izvrsne računalne vještine
  • prethodno iskustvo rada u istraživačkom laboratoriju
  • iskustvo u osnovnim tehnikama molekularne biologije i razdvajanju glikoproteina

Dodatni kriteriji:

  • iskustvo u tehnikama analitičke kromatografije
  • iskustvo u analizi proteina i/ili glikana pomoću masene spektrometrije
  • poznavanje bioinformatičkih alata za analizu glikopeptida (npr. ProteinScape™, DataAnalysis™)
  • iskustvo u razvoju metoda za analizu glikopeptida masenom spektrometrijom
  • prethodno sudjelovanje u znanstveno-istraživačkom radu i osobna izlaganja na znanstvenim konferencijama

Prijava na natječaj treba sadržavati:

  • motivacijsko pismo
  • životopis
  • dokaz o završenom doktorskom studiju

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 7 dana od dana objave u Narodnim novinama.

Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati.

Molimo zainteresirane da prijave šalju na e-mail adresu dpeic@genos.hr te da u predmetu e-maila stave naznaku „GlycoBrain - za natječaj".
Genos d.o.o. raspisuje novi natječaj za zapošljavanje postdoktoranda na HRZZ projektu GlycoBrain - Dekodiranje moždanog glikoma.
Call for Postdoctoral Researcher – HRZZ GlycoBrain Project (2)

Genos Ltd for Assessment and Analysis is inviting applications for one (1) postdoctoral researcher position to participate in a research project entitled "Decoding the Brain's Glycome: A Targeted Glycoproteomic Exploration of the Human Brain" (acronym: GlycoBrain) funded by the "Research Project" Program of the Croatian Science Foundation:

  • Position: one (1) postdoctoral researcher will participate in all project activities related to analysis of protein glycosylation, under the supervision of Dr. Thomas Klarić (Genos)

The appointment will be a full-time employment for the duration of the research project (until 30th November 2027).

Required conditions:

  • completed relevant Ph.D. programme in the field of natural sciences (molecular biology, experimental biology, biochemistry) or biomedicine and health (medicine, pharmacy, medical biochemistry)
  • excellent knowledge of the English language and excellent computer skills
  • previous experience working in a research laboratory
  • experience in basic molecular biology techniques and separation of glycoproteins

Additional criteria:

  • experience in analytical chromatography techniques
  • experience of protein and/or glycan analysis by mass spectrometry
  • knowledge of data analysis and visualization and statistical data analysis using Python
  • knowledge of bioinformatic tools for glycopeptide analysis (e.g. ProteinScape™, DataAnalysis™)

The application should contain the following documents:

  • motivation letter
  • Curriculum vitae
  • proof that applicant has been awarded a Ph.D.

Job application can be submitted by persons of both sexes.

The application deadline is 7 days from the date of publication of the call for applications in the Official Gazette (Narodne novine).

Incomplete and untimely applications will not be considered.

Interested candidates should send their application to the email address dpeic@genos.hr; the email subject line should include "GlycoBrain-Job application".

Call for Postdoctoral Researcher – HRZZ GlycoBrain Project

Genos d.o.o. for expertise and analysis is opening a call for the employment of one (1) employee (m/f) for the position of postdoctoral researcher on the Croatian Science Foundation "Research Project" Programme project "Decoding the Brain Glycome: Targeted Glycoproteomic Investigation of the Human Brain" (acronym: GlycoBrain):

  • Position: one (1) postdoctoral researcher for work on project activities involving the analysis of protein glycosylation under the mentorship of Dr. Thomas Klarić (Genos)

The employment contract is for a fixed term for the duration of the project (until 30 November 2027) on a full-time basis.

Mandatory requirements:

  • completed relevant doctoral degree in the field of natural sciences (molecular biology, experimental biology, biochemistry) or biomedicine and health (medicine, pharmacy, medical biochemistry)
  • knowledge of the English language and computer skills
  • previous laboratory experience and experience in basic techniques of molecular biology and proteomics

Additional criteria:

  • experience working in an international laboratory
  • knowledge of chromatographic analytical methods
  • experience in protein and/or glycan analysis by mass spectrometry
  • knowledge of data analysis and visualization and statistical data analysis in R
  • knowledge of bioinformatics tools for glycopeptide analysis (e.g. ProteinScape™, DataAnalysis™)
  • experience in developing methods for glycopeptide analysis by mass spectrometry
  • previous participation in scientific research and personal presentations at scientific conferences

The application should include:

  • cover letter
  • curriculum vitae
  • proof of completed doctoral studies
  • letter of recommendation from a former or current mentor or employer

Applications are open to candidates of both sexes.

The application deadline is 7 days from the date of publication in the Official Gazette (Narodne novine).

Incomplete and late applications will not be considered.

Interested candidates should send their applications to the email address dpeic@genos.hr
